tasks.title: Integrate official Anthropic SDK dependency and authorize in dependency policy
steps: Add github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go pinned to a specific minor version in go.mod and run go mod tidy
Update internal/policy/deps_test.go to add github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go to the direct dependency allowlist table
Write unit tests TS-10-1 and TS-10-2 asserting the pinned SDK in go.mod and its authorization in internal/policy/deps_test.go
Refactor provider/anthropic to import the official SDK client and deprecate hand-rolled HTTP transport, provider/sse.go streaming parsers, and custom credential stores
Write unit test TS-10-3 confirming the Anthropic provider delegates transport and stream decoding directly to official SDK client primitives

tasks.title: Implement unified Direct, Vertex AI, and Bedrock environment resolution
steps: Define the Env interface and MapEnv implementation in provider/anthropic to allow isolated variable lookups without mutating process environment
Define typed Source constants SourceDirect, SourceVertex, and SourceBedrock
Implement anthropic.Resolve(env Env) (*anthropic.Client, Source, error) checking CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX and CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK flags with truthy and explicit off ('0' and 'false') handling
Configure SourceVertex with ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID (or GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT), CLOUD_ML_REGION (defaulting to 'global'), and optional ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL
Configure SourceBedrock with AWS Bedrock client options

Configure SourceDirect reading ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN) and optional ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, and return a descriptive missing credentials error if neither cloud flag nor API key is present
Write unit tests TS-10-4 through TS-10-10 in provider/anthropic/resolve_test.go verifying Direct, Vertex, and Bedrock resolution offline without network calls

tasks.title: Shrink model catalog to Claude lookups with safe uncataloged model defaults
steps: Prune catalog/catalog.json by removing all non-Claude vendor models (OpenAI, Google) and keeping only Claude model descriptors
Delete catalog/resolve.go, catalog/resolve_test.go, catalog/clamp.go, and catalog/clamp_test.go
Implement catalog.Lookup(id string) (core.Model, bool) in catalog/catalog.go stripping optional 'anthropic/' prefix and matching Claude entries

Return a default core.Model descriptor (requested ID, 1,000,000 context window, 128,000 max output, ThinkingKindAdaptive, zero cost rates) and false when querying uncataloged models without returning errors
Verify that model pricing rates and token limits reside exclusively in catalog without hardcoded values in provider/anthropic
Write unit tests TS-10-11, TS-10-12, TS-10-13, TS-10-15 and property test TS-10-14 in catalog/catalog_test.go

tasks.title: Implement adaptive thinking Effort levels and request payload encoding
steps: Define Effort type in package core with discrete constants EffortLow ('low'), EffortMedium ('medium'), EffortHigh ('high'), EffortXHigh ('xhigh'), and EffortMax ('max')
Update request encoder to emit thinking: {type: 'adaptive'} and output_config: {effort: '<level>'} without budget_tokens when adaptive thinking is active
Emit budget_tokens and omit output_config.effort when legacy budget thinking is explicitly configured on the model
Omit thinking and output_config parameters entirely when a model's catalog entry does not support reasoning effort, without mutating or clamping the request
Write unit tests TS-10-16, TS-10-17, TS-10-18, and TS-10-19 verifying Effort definitions and wire thinking payload encoding

tasks.title: Implement strict tool serialization and schema metadata projection
steps: Update wire tool serialization in provider/anthropic to set strict: true unconditionally on all tool definitions
Strip internal tool metadata fields OutputSchema, ReachableTools, and Terminating (and their snake_case variants) before serializing tool definitions
Omit forced tool choice ('any' or named tool locks) on the wire, defaulting to 'auto' or omitting tool_choice
Write unit tests TS-10-20, TS-10-21, and TS-10-22 asserting strict: true, absence of internal metadata, and tool choice behavior

tasks.title: Enforce tool argument raw byte preservation and prompt cache breakpoints
steps: Ensure assistant tool_use blocks preserve raw json.RawMessage argument bytes without unmarshaling or re-serializing across multi-turn histories
Add ephemeral cache_control ({type: 'ephemeral'}) to the final content block of the system prompt
Add ephemeral cache_control to the final tool definition in the tools list
Add ephemeral cache_control to the final content block of prefix messages if prefix messages exist
Add ephemeral cache_control to the final content block of user message history
Write unit tests TS-10-23, TS-10-24, and TS-10-25 validating byte preservation of tool arguments and precise placement of cache control breakpoints

tasks.title: Implement Anthropic SDK response translation, stream decoding, and token accounting
steps: Implement message translation from SDK Message payloads into core.AssistantMessage with TextBlock, ThinkingBlock, and ToolUseBlock content
Translate streaming chunks and message deltas, capturing input, output, cache read, and cache creation token counts into core.Usage and incrementing request count
Ensure streaming event forwarding into the agent event stream runs without blocking the provider loop on slow consumers
Write unit tests TS-10-26, TS-10-27, and TS-10-28 validating response translation, usage accounting, and non-blocking streaming behavior

tasks.title: Pin Anthropic wire serialization with updated golden request tests
steps: Update testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json to reflect SDK wire serialization containing strict tools, adaptive thinking effort, and ephemeral prompt caching
Rewrite golden_requests_test.go to assert wire request bodies generated for Anthropic match request_anthropic.json byte-for-byte
Assert that cache_control appears exactly on the last system block, last tool, last prefix block, and last user block
Assert that all tools have strict: true and that OutputSchema, reachable_tools, and terminating do not appear in the payload
Assert that adaptive models emit thinking: {type: 'adaptive'} and output_config.effort without budget_tokens
Assert that replayed tool_use arguments match the input fixture byte-for-byte
Execute tests TS-10-29 through TS-10-33 and verify golden comparisons pass
